page.overview:
Who is Ashoona?

He served for a long time as zongdu, and increasingly suffered from health issues as he became elderly, including loss of concentration and repeated bouts of illness. Compared to other shang leaders, Ashoona was viewed as a "kindly" figure.

In the convocation between zongdus and world leaders in year 16 of the era of Yangchen, Ashoona played Sparrowbones with Iwashi, and was trounced so badly that he refused to touch a tile afterward. Increasingly suffering from illness, Yangchen believed that Ashoona was unlikely to be a player in the political game around the Unanimity crisis.

In the late year 17 of era of Yangchen, Ashoona arrived in Taku for the yearly convocation just after recovering from a lingering illness. When Yangchen arrived at the council hall, Ashoona was sitting in a place of prominence with Iwashi and Chaisee, and raised a hand in greeting to the Avatar.

When the day's meeting reached a midway lull, Ashoona began to forget details about certain clauses, with Chaisee snapping at him to make a "yea" or "nay" vote. Ashoona stated that he had lost track of the contract, and asked to start the contract over. When the merchants in the hall began to groan, Yangchen's companion, "Master Lio", began to speak unprompted to the zongdu, informing Ashoona that there was a three in ten chance of a tremendous risk, weighed against a seven in ten chance of a paltry reward, recounting the specific number of ingots Ashoona would lose or gain. Ashoona asked if Lio had kept a running tally, to which he stated that he had only kept a mental record of his calculations. Iwashi's accountants verified Lio's figures, and the Avatar's companion bowed deeply before Ashoona, apologizing for his impertinence, while stating that he did not want a business partner mistakenly enter a poor deal. He also made an intentional reference to Sparrowbones as he did so, intentionally attracting the attention of Iwashi. Ashoona offered his thanks to Lio, appreciating his honesty.
